raw_site_text: 125 villages in Gopalganj and 125 villages in Matlab upazilas (subdistricts)
justification: Villages were sampled in Gopalganj and Matlab upazilas, which roll up to Dhaka and Chittagong divisions respectively.
note: Gopalganj and Matlab are named by the paper; the division assignment (Gopalganj in Dhaka; Matlab in Chandpur, Chittagong) comes from outside geographic knowledge.
